metadata.name: AddBillPaySubscriber
metadata.description: Use this API  to allow the service consumer to add (enrol) a new subscriber for a specific FI and product.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: DDANumber
request_fields.description: This is the DDA (Direct Deposit Account) which can be used in ACH transactions. Valid values : 0-9 Example:1234567890 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: This represents the subscriber associated user’s first name. Valid Values: A-Z, a-z Example: Andrew Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: MiddleName
request_fields.description: This represents the subscriber associated user’s middle name. Valid values: A-Z, a-z Example: Charles Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: This represents the subscriber associated user’s last name. Valid values: A-Z, a-z Example: Hudson Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: EmailAddress
request_fields.description: This is the email address of the Payee. Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9. Example: sem_pp1 @gmail.com Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PhoneNumber
request_fields.description: This is the phone number, including area code, for the Payee. This is a numeric field that will not accept hyphens.                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9812338769 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: AccountType
request_fields.description: This is the type of funding account. Valid values are: D – Checking(default value) S – Savings Example: D, S. Condition: This field is mandatory when the 'PayeeClsf' is 'Indv' (Individual/Person) Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: SubscriberType
request_fields.description: This is the subscriber type for the specified subscriber. Valid Values: Comp  -Company, Indv- Individual Example: Comp, Indv. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CustomerId
request_fields.description: This is the optional element represents identification that is common between the Service Provider(iPay Solutions) and Service Consumer associated with an individual subscriber. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 4545

request_fields.name: DateOfBirth
request_fields.description: This is the subscriber’s date of birth. Example: 2015-12-11T00:00:00 Format : YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss

request_fields.name: AddressModel
request_fields.description: Address Model

request_fields.name: AddressType
request_fields.description: This is the  address  type for the payee. The Payee’s primary (i.e., payment remittance) address is required when adding a new Payee. Valid values are: Prim - Primary(default) Rush - Rush Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Addressline1
request_fields.description: This is the street address for the payee. Example: One Main St Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: Addressline2
request_fields.description: This is the second line of the street address for the payee. Example: Apt A Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: City
request_fields.description: This is the city for the payee. Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross Allowable Values: 75

request_fields.name: State
request_fields.description: This is the 2-character alpha code approved by the USPS which represents a state for the payee. Example: GA Valid values are A-Z, a-z Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: Postalcode
request_fields.description: This is the postal or ZIP code for the payee. (ZIP+4 is supported.) Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Allowable Values: 10

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: SubscriberId
children.description: This is the Service Provider's (iPay Solutions) identifier for the Cardholder User. Example : 12345678
